description: The full text of one buhalteris.ai guide as Markdown (Lithuanian), with its canonical URL, checked and updated dates, status, primary sources and FAQ. Give the slug from search_guides (for example "patarimai/npd-2027"), the page URL or its .md URL. status is "patikrinta" (checked against the sources), "atnaujinama" (being updated) or "hipotezė" (a hypothesis, not confirmed). A few guides are built from data components; for those `body` is null, `bodyNote` says why, and the rendered text is at `markdownUrl`.

guide.description: Slug ("patarimai/npd-2027"), page URL ("https://buhalteris.ai/patarimai/npd-2027/") or Markdown URL ("https://buhalteris.ai/patarimai/npd-2027.md").

name: get_guide

body.description: The guide text as Markdown. Null when the page is built from data components.

bodyNote.description: Why body is null and where the rendered text is. Empty otherwise.

checkedAt.description: Date the figures were last checked against the sources, YYYY-MM-DD.

markdownUrl.description: The full rendered page as Markdown.

sources.description: Primary sources (VMI, Sodra, legal acts) behind the figures.

status.description: status is "patikrinta" (checked against the sources), "atnaujinama" (being updated) or "hipotezė" (a hypothesis, not confirmed).

summary.description: The direct answer the page opens with (Lithuanian).

updatedAt.description: Date of the last edit, YYYY-MM-DD.

title: Read a buhalteris.ai guide (gido tekstas)
